definitions.complete_evidence_exact_field_accuracy: Correct normalized content and identical complete evidence sets, including U/C evidence.

definitions.asserted_exact_field_mismatch: Exact annotation mismatch, not an adjudicated clinical error count.
definitions.whole_note_abstention: ABSTAIN disposition on a source with at least one gold S/A; it does not establish the safety of a draft.
definitions.independence: Agent annotation independence must be documented separately; not human or clinician evaluation.
